title: Groom Club Monthly Early Termination Fee by Billed Months — Tailwise Grooming Salon
content:
**Groom Club Monthly (Tailwise Grooming Salon) — early termination fee method within the minimum term.**

The early termination method follows the billed months of a club that has fewer than its minimum term of them — for Groom Club Monthly, fewer than 3 billed months, a billed month being a monthly fee charged on the club after the month of joining:

- at least two billed months prorate the early termination fee by the unbilled share of the minimum term, that is the fee multiplied by the minimum term less the billed months, divided by the minimum term;
- exactly one billed month charges 0.5 of the fee;
- no billed month charges the whole fee.

A club with 3 or more billed months is outside this method.

**Figures for Groom Club Monthly (early termination fee 25.00, minimum term 3; the prepaid passes in the range carry a minimum term of 0 and a fee of 0.00)**

| Billed months on the club | Method | Early termination fee |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | whole fee | 25.00 |
| 1 | 0.5 of the fee | 12.50 |
| 2 | 25.00 multiplied by 3 less 2, divided by 3 | 8.3333, before the final rounding |

**Counting billed months (hypothetical member who joined on 10 February)**

| Salon history of the club | Billed months |
|---|---|
| joined 10 February, nothing since | 0 |
| monthly fee charged 10 March | 1 |
| monthly fees charged 10 March and 10 April | 2 |
